title: When More Documents Hurt RAG: Measuring and Reducing Vector Search Dilution with Domain-Scoped Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2606.11350v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) degrades when applied to large, heterogeneous document collections. In RAG systems, dense similarity becomes less discriminative, causing top-$k$ retrieval to return semantically similar but contextually incorrect chunks. We refer to this failure mode as vector search dilution. Even under hybrid dense+sparse retrieval, we first observed it in a deployed Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) system; in a controlled experiment, growing the corpus from 54 to 1,128 documents cut precision@10 by 63% and recall of the answer-bearing document by 23%. Similar patterns were observed in six other DOTs. To diagnose this issue, we introduce MASDR-RAG (Metadata-Scoped Domain Retrieval for RAG) as a controlled testbed over 200 human-validated queries, five LLM backbones, six public benchmark corpora, and two index stacks. In MASDR-RAG, domain scoping is the load-bearing component. We found hard partition

translated_title: 当更多文档反而损害RAG：通过领域范围检索测量并减少向量搜索稀释
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）在应用于大型异构文档集合时会出现性能退化。在RAG系统中，稠密相似度的区分性下降，导致top-k检索返回语义相似但上下文错误的文本块。我们将这种失败模式称为向量搜索稀释（vector search dilution）。即使在混合稠密+稀疏检索下，我们首先在实际部署的怀俄明州交通部（WYDOT）系统中观察到了这一现象；在对照实验中，语料库规模从54个文档增长到1,128个文档，使precision@10下降了63%，包含答案文档的召回率下降了23%。在其他六个州交通部（DOT）中也观察到了类似模式。为了诊断这一问题，我们引入了MASDR-RAG（面向RAG的元数据范围领域检索），作为一个受控测试平台，涵盖200个经人工验证的查询、五个LLM骨干模型、六个公开基准语料库和两种索引技术栈。在MASDR-RAG中，领域范围限定是起关键支撑作用的组件。我们发现硬分区
tldr: 论文揭示了大语料库下RAG的“向量搜索稀释”问题（precision@10下降63%），并基于200个验证查询、五个LLM骨干和六个基准语料库的MASDR-RAG测试平台证明，基于元数据的领域范围限定是缓解该问题的关键组件。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies "vector search dilution" in RAG, where growing corpora from 54 to 1,128 documents cut precision@10 by 63%, and introduces the MASDR-RAG testbed to show that metadata-based domain scoping is the load-bearing component for mitigating this failure mode.
